Package io.goobi.viewer.model.archives

Class CardCatalogManager

java.lang.Object
io.goobi.viewer.model.archives.CardCatalogManager
public class CardCatalogManager extends Object
Application-wide manager for card catalog indexes: builds and caches a compact positional index per card catalog archive and answers the interval, list and register lookups of the card catalog REST API. Deliberately does not use ArchiveManager's full archive trees; a card catalog with hundreds of thousands of nodes must never be materialized as ArchiveEntry objects. Card pages and associated records are queried on demand.

    • getCatalog

      public Optional<CardCatalogIndex> getCatalog(String pi) throws PresentationException, IndexUnreachableException
      Returns the (possibly cached) card catalog index for the given archive resource. Staleness against the Solr index is checked via DATEINDEXED, throttled to one lookup per minute per catalog.
      Parameters:
      pi - PI of the archive resource
      Returns:
      the index, or empty if no archive with the given PI is indexed
      Throws:
      PresentationException
      IndexUnreachableException

    • getBoundaryPositions

      public List<Integer> getBoundaryPositions(CardCatalogDrawer drawer, Integer from, Integer to)
      Returns the boundary cards of one zoom step: zoomFactor + 1 cards evenly distributed over the position interval [from, to] of the given drawer.
      Parameters:
      drawer - drawer to resolve positions in
      from - 1-based start position; values out of range are clamped
      to - 1-based end position; values out of range are clamped
      Returns:
      boundary positions (1-based) in ascending order, without duplicates

    • findEntryPosition

      public Optional<org.apache.commons.lang3.tuple.ImmutablePair<CardCatalogDrawer,Integer>> findEntryPosition(CardCatalogIndex index, String entryId) throws PresentationException, IndexUnreachableException
      Locates a card within the catalog by its EAD node ID: the drawer containing it and its 1-based position within that drawer. Current indexes store a dense, zero-based sibling order, which is verified against the sorted card at that position. Otherwise the position is derived from two Solr count queries (siblings sorting before the card) and verified the same way; as a last resort the first MAX_POSITION_SCAN_PAGES pages of the drawer are scanned.
      Parameters:
      index - card catalog index
      entryId - EAD node ID of the card
      Returns:
      drawer and 1-based position; empty if the entry is not part of a drawer of this catalog or could not be located
      Throws:
      PresentationException
      IndexUnreachableException

    • getBackSideFiles

      public Map<String,String> getBackSideFiles(Collection<String> recordPis) throws PresentationException, IndexUnreachableException
      Finds the back of each given card record: the first further image in the format of the front. Header strips and other excerpts differ in format and are left out; images without indexed dimensions never count as a back.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
